question: Select the INCORRECT combination of dance and its respective state of origin.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sattriya – Himachal Pradesh**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sattriya** is a classical dance form that originated in **Assam**, not Himachal Pradesh.
 
• **Bharatanatyam** is correctly associated with **Tamil Nadu**.
 
• **Kuchipudi** is correctly associated with **Andhra Pradesh**.
 
• **Kathakali** is correctly associated with **Kerala**.
 
• The incorrect combination in the given options is **Option 1: Sattriya – Himachal Pradesh**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sattriya** dance was introduced in the 15th century A.D by the Vaishnavite saint and reformer Mahapurusha Sankaradeva as a powerful medium for propagation of the Vaishnav religion.
 
• It is one of the eight principal classical Indian dance traditions.
 
• The dance form is named after the **Sattras**, which are Vaishnavite monasteries that were established in Assam.
